---
title: "Main figures for the manuscript"
format:
  typst:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          #set par.line(numbering: "1", numbering-scope: "page")

          // Hide the bare auto-caption Quarto generates from each float's `{#tbl-...}` /
          // `{#fig-...}` id. Every float in this file has an EMPTY caption, so that caption
          // renders as the label and nothing else ("Table S1"), directly adjacent to the
          // hand-written legend paragraph that already opens with the same label. The id
          // still has to be there -- it is the cross-reference target -- so the caption is
          // suppressed at render time instead.
          //
          // SCOPED TO THIS DOCUMENT ON PURPOSE. Putting this in ms/_metadata.yml would also
          // blank the manuscript's pseudo-figure pages, and ms/post_process_pdf.sh IDENTIFIES
          // those pages by matching their bare float labels -- manuscript assembly would fail
          // outright with "no cross-reference placeholder pages found".
          //
          // A document-level include-in-header MERGES with the one in ms/_metadata.yml rather
          // than replacing it (verified 2026-08-27: the supplement-space rules still fire, so
          // references read "Table S1", not "Table S 1"). The condition keeps a real caption
          // rendering if one is ever added.
          // An "empty" caption is not `[]`: Quarto wraps it, and its repr is
          // `sequence([ ], block(body: [ ]), [ ])` (dumped from the render on 2026-08-27).
          // Comparing to `[]` therefore silently never matches and the rule looks broken.
          #show figure.caption: it => {
            if repr(it.body).contains("block(body: [ ])") { none } else { it }
          }
---
